slides.say: Event handlers are your own functions that React runs when the user clicks, hovers, or types.
Three steps. Declare a function inside the component. Put your logic in it. Then pass it to the button as onClick.

slides.text: Defined inside the component, so it can read props and state.
slides.say: Because the handler lives inside your component, it can read the props and state of that component.

slides.text: Convention: handle + event name. handleClick, handleMouseEnter.
slides.say: By convention, name it handle, followed by the event. Handle click, handle mouse enter.
